# A person can write a harness by hand: it is validated like a learned one, then adopted
$ shep learn adopt --from-dir .github/pr-assets/self-learning/demo/harness-v1 --repo ~/shop
✓ Imported and adopted 065eb057
$ shep learn history --repo ~/shop
